## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] A real affected browser path was exercised, or the unverified scope is stated below
- [ ] Sensitive values and private browsing data are absent from tests, logs, and screenshots
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when behavior changes

## Browser coverage

List the browsers and connection modes tested. Explain any skipped path.

## Safety and compatibility

Describe permission, approval, profile, native-input, or backward-compatibility impact.
